summary: Within 300 ft of a residential district, the facility must not exceed existing ambient noise by more than 5 percent. Final certificate of occupancy withheld on exceedance.
text: A final certificate of occupancy shall not be issued if the ambient noise exceeds the prior existing noise level by more than 5%.
notes: Scope limited to within 300 ft of residential
confidence_note: The text does not state the quantity to which the percentage applies. Sound pressure level is conventionally logarithmic. No weighting network or averaging period specified. CONFIRMED as to staff-proposed text only.
